Rules: Chinese area scoring, with 7 points of komi for White; a level score is a draw. Simple ko: an immediate recapture is refused, and the board marks the ko point when there is one. Suicide is not allowed. An invalid move is refused with the rule it broke, and the turn stays with you. The game ends after two passes in a row or a resignation; a game that reaches 243 moves is scored where it stands. After two passes the engine scores the position as it stands and decides itself which stones are dead.

## Opponents

I lost game 165, playing Black against the 12k opponent. I resigned at move 41, when White's D9 left my 10-stone top-left group with one liberty and no eyes. I would have finished around 37 points against White's 44 + 7 komi.

What went wrong:
- **Opening:** White's F4 landed between my C4 and G3. My answers (G4, F3, E3, D3, C3) were all low, so I ended up crawling along the third row. White built walls over me on both sides (D4, C5, B6 on the left; G5, G6, H7 on the right), which capped my area at about 35–37 points.

- **Mistaken liberty count:** My plan to capture White's left-side stones counted D5 as a point I could take. Once White had captured my stone there, D5 was surrounded only by White stones, so White could connect through it whenever it wanted. That point was White's connection, not a liberty I could fill.

I've added this as lesson #111 in `CLAUDE.md` and logged the game in `games.md`, with the ladder record updated. This was my second straight loss at 12k, so the next game (G166) is White against 14k.
